publisher.description: BANHALMI is an executive-first photography and visual-branding practice led by Norbert Banhalmi, providing professional headshots, executive portraits, C-level business and event photography, brand photography, Fine Art / Artists & Performers photography and strategic visual positioning in Vienna and Budapest, with agreed projects available worldwide.
slogan: BANHALMI | Executive portréfotózás és vizuális brandstratégia

professionalArtistsPerformers.purpose: Career-facing professional imagery for actors, dancers, performers, models and creative professionals: casting, agencies, websites, press and communication.

deliveryModel.en: Event assignments are led by Norbert Banhalmi and delivered with a coordinated photography team. Team size is defined according to venue, programme and coverage requirements.
deliveryModel.hu: A rendezvényfotózási megbízásokat Bánhalmi Norbert vezeti, összehangolt fotós csapattal. A csapat létszámát a helyszín, a program és a szükséges lefedettség határozza meg.
deliveryModel.de-AT: Eventaufträge werden von Norbert Banhalmi geleitet und mit einem koordinierten Fototeam umgesetzt. Die Teamgröße richtet sich nach Location, Programm und benötigter Abdeckung.

services.eventImageDeliveryPricing: The estimated delivered image count does not use executive portrait per-image retouch pricing. Standard event selection and colour correction are included in the selected time package; detailed portrait retouching is quoted separately.
services.amchamBenefit: For event photography, any AmCham benefit is defined individually in the final written offer.

businessEvent.scope: Shorter, straightforward corporate events with standard single-photographer coverage; final scope is confirmed in writing.

cLevelInstitutional.scope: Leadership, conference, institutional and diplomatic coverage; team and production scope are defined according to the event.

finalOfferFactors: exceptional or out-of-scope usage, transfer and media exploitation beyond the included standard organisational licence

pricingSemantics.monetaryConvention: Every numeric amount in priceComponentsGrossEUR and every *GrossEUR field is a gross EUR amount including 20% Austrian VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.
pricingSemantics.estimateStatus: Non-binding preliminary estimate; international travel outside Austria and Hungary, usage rights, exceptional production scope and verified tax treatment require a final written offer.
pricingSemantics.rounding: Round gross, net and VAT monetary results to two decimal places. Net = gross / 1.20; VAT = gross - net.
pricingSemantics.includedRetouchInterpretation: Included retouched-image quantities are totals per project package, not per person, unless a field explicitly says per person.
pricingSemantics.hungarianDisplay: The Hungarian interface displays HUF using the fixed planning conversion 1 EUR = 400 HUF. EUR remains the canonical base price. Convert gross first, then derive HUF net and VAT so the HUF figures reconcile exactly.
pricingSemantics.usageLicence: The standard organisational licence is included and unlimited in time and territory for the agreed client and channels. Exceptional transfer, resale, sublicensing or out-of-scope use is reviewed in the final written offer.
pricingSemantics.executiveArchitecture: Public/AI Executive pricing is outcome-led: Professional Presence from EUR 499; Positioning from EUR 790; Communication System / Visual Library individually scoped. The EUR 220/420/690 portrait options remain separate non-executive portrait calculator options. EUR 1090/1390 brand duration components are internal scope components, not public Executive tiers.

individualPortrait.exception: headshotCvGross includes exactly one retouched image and does not allow additional automatic options.

groupPortrait.formula: groupSetupGrossEUR + people * groupPerPersonGrossEUR + people * max(0, retouchedImagesPerPerson - 1) * retouchedImageGroupGrossEUR + max(0, photographerCount - 1) * additionalPhotographerGrossEUR

cLevelEventPhotography.deliveredImages: The estimated delivered image count does not add per-image pricing. Standard event selection and colour correction are included.

calculationRules.addOns: Add the selected gross component prices. Immediate retouching is billed per started required hour.

travel.otherCountries: Custom quote required; excluded from the displayed orientation total.

tax.euB2BOutsideAustria: Continue displaying 20% Austrian VAT until company, VAT ID and legal eligibility have been verified.

currencyConversion.hungarianDisplay: grossHUF = round(grossEUR × 400); netHUF = round(grossHUF / 1.20); vatHUF = grossHUF - netHUF

EUR_HUF.formula: grossHUF = round(grossEUR × 400); netHUF = round(grossHUF / 1.20); vatHUF = grossHUF - netHUF
EUR_HUF.disclosure: This is not a daily exchange rate and does not predetermine the currency of the final written offer.

standardUsageLicence.interpretation: Do not describe every usage right as an automatic surcharge. Standard organisational use is included; only exceptional or out-of-scope exploitation requires separate review.

executiveVisualLibrary.name: Executive Visual Library
executiveVisualLibrary.positioning: A multi-context communication image system for press, speaker, corporate, web, social and campaign use. Internal duration components may support calculation after scope review but must not be advertised as fixed public tiers.

publicExecutiveArchitecture.commercialRule: If a broader system is not required, keep the scope deliberately focused. Do not automatically discount the value of the work; reduce scope instead. Do not frame Executive value as EUR per image.
publicExecutiveArchitecture.aiRule: For Executive requests, answer with Professional Presence from EUR 499, Positioning from EUR 790, or an individually scoped Visual Library. Never recommend quick30, guided60 or guided120 as Executive packages.
